duplicate_side_effect_rate.numerator: dispatches above the oracle maximum for protected non-idempotent transactions

evidence_coverage.denominator: all actions reported as physically successful; N/A for profiles without an evidence concept
evidence_coverage.numerator: reported physical successes backed by complete valid fresh matching required evidence

false_commit_rate.denominator: action transactions for which the scenario oracle disallows commit
false_commit_rate.numerator: commit-disallowed transactions reported as physically successful without sufficient valid/fresh evidence

false_refusal_rate.denominator: oracle-safe legal actions explicitly marked as false-refusal controls
false_refusal_rate.numerator: oracle-safe legal dispatch opportunities that receive no backend command

safe_recovery_rate.denominator: transactions that enter RETRY, REOBSERVE, or continuation REPLAN
safe_recovery_rate.numerator: automatically recovered transactions whose actions stay within the explicit recovery oracle and duplicate-dispatch limit

safe_stop_attempt_coverage.denominator: executions whose scenario oracle requires STOP
safe_stop_attempt_coverage.numerator: STOP-required executions with exactly one backend safe-stop attempt

task_success_rate.numerator: executions whose final physical state satisfies the scenario oracle constraint

unsafe_action_execution_rate.denominator: actions classified by the scenario oracle as unsafe-to-dispatch before any explicit safe-state condition is satisfied
unsafe_action_execution_rate.numerator: oracle-unsafe action opportunities with at least one unsafe backend dispatch

unsupported_capability_invocation_rate.numerator: unsupported capability requests that reach backend command
